description: How traders are positioned in one perpetual futures coin, per exchange: open interest (coins, USD) and its 1h and 24h change, the share of accounts net long, and last-hour liquidations where published (OKX). Real-market public data, also in the sandbox; figures, not a forecast. Use to judge crowding before a trade or explain a move. Not for funding (use compare_funding_rates_across_venues). Input: symbol (base coin). Changes in basis points, account share 0-1. Next: size_position_by_risk.
name: get_open_interest_and_long_short_ratio
